decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development shall be in accordance with those shown in the elevations and application form hereby approved, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p>The windows and roof lights in the upper floor elevations of the proposed development shall:</p><p>(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,</p><p>(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shall thereafter be retained in that form.</p>

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="line-height: 107%;">Planning Statement; Design and Access Statement; <span class="msoIns" style="">01;
02; 03; 04; 05; 06; 07; 08; 09; 10; 11; 12; 13; 14; 15; 16; 17.&nbsp;</span></span>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original planning permission&nbsp;PL/0565/23 dated 01.07.2024.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning permission PL/0565/23 dated 1.7.23 to allow full width extension of single storey rear extension.  At first floor level, extend width of existing two storey rear extension
